faqs.question: When is Propose Day 2027?
faqs.answer: Propose Day 2027 is Monday 8 February. It is the second day of Valentine week: Rose Day falls on Sunday 7 February 2027 and Valentine's Day on Sunday 14 February 2027.

faqs.question: Is Propose Day on 7 February or 8 February?
faqs.answer: 8 February. 7 February is Rose Day, which opens the week. Some pages get this wrong, so check it before you schedule anything — in 2027 the 7th is a Sunday and the 8th a Monday.

faqs.question: Should I use তুমি or আপনি when I propose in Bengali?
faqs.answer: তুমি for almost everyone. আপনি is the formal tier used with strangers, colleagues and older people, so it reads cold in a proposal unless you genuinely have not moved off it yet — for instance an introduction arranged by families.

faqs.question: Is it ever okay to propose using তুই?
faqs.answer: Only if the two of you have been on তুই with each other since childhood. Research on Bengali address forms lists তুই among its uses for hostile or angry speech and for talking down, so used on the wrong person it reads as contempt.

faqs.question: Can I run an English proposal line through a translator and send the Bengali?
faqs.answer: It is risky. A 2026 benchmark of twelve large language models on 1,719 Bangla instances found they frequently default to overly formal address forms, which means your line is likely to come back in আপনি and read distant.

faqs.question: Do these Bengali lines work in both West Bengal and Bangladesh?
faqs.answer: Yes. All 14 avoid words that split across the border, such as জল versus পানি. The one usage difference to watch is তুই, which travels less far in a romantic register in Bangladesh than in West Bengal.

faqs.question: What does ভালোবাসি mean, and can I send it on its own?
faqs.answer: It means "I love you". It carries no second-person pronoun, so it is safe whichever tier you are on, and it works as a complete message by itself. That is why it is the first line on this page.

faqs.question: How do I type Bengali script on my phone?
faqs.answer: Both Android and iOS ship Bengali keyboards you enable in keyboard settings, and Gboard also offers Bengali transliteration, so typing "bhalobashi" in Roman letters produces ভালোবাসি. Copying the lines above works too.

faqs.question: Should I send the line as text or as a picture?
faqs.answer: Send text. Bengali Unicode renders correctly in WhatsApp and SMS, and text can be copied, searched and read aloud by a screen reader. An image quote card takes 10 to 20 minutes to make and loses all three.

faqs.question: What is the difference between a Propose Day quote and a Propose Day wish?
faqs.answer: A quote is a standalone line you can post or send to anyone; a wish is addressed to one named person and usually opens with a greeting. This page is deliberately the first kind.

faqs.question: Is it better to propose in Bengali or in English?
faqs.answer: In whichever language the two of you already use with each other. A sudden switch to Bengali with someone you have always spoken English with reads as a performance, and you have no established pronoun tier to fall back on.

article.contentMarkdown:
# Propose Day Quotes in Bengali: Lines That Fit Who You Are Asking

Propose day quotes in Bengali only work if the pronoun is right. Bengali makes you choose between তুই, তুমি and আপনি before you get near the romance, and the verb ending changes with the choice. This page gives 14 original lines in Bengali script, each with a Roman transliteration and an English gloss, sorted by which of the three you are entitled to use.

Propose Day 2027 falls on Monday 8 February, the second day of Valentine week. Two SubhSandesh numbers matter before you plan delivery, both platform-wide across all 16 page types: 39.9% of creators password-protect a page before sharing it (1,822 of 4,567), and 48.9% of the 51,504 recorded views happen on a phone.

## Propose Day 2027 is Monday 8 February, not the 7th

Propose Day 2027 falls on **Monday 8 February**. Rose Day opens the week on Sunday 7 February 2027; Valentine's Day closes it on Sunday 14 February 2027.

The weekday matters. Propose Day 2026 fell on a Sunday; 2027 drops it inside a working week, so the window is a lunch break, an evening, or a message timed in advance. Several pages ranking for this query still carry 2024 or 2025.

## What is a Propose Day quote in Bengali?

A Propose Day quote in Bengali is a short line in Bengali script — not transliterated Hindi, not Assamese — for saying or sending on 8 February. It differs from an English quote structurally: Bengali encodes your relationship inside the grammar, so you cannot write the line until you have settled what that relationship is.

English has one second-person pronoun. Bengali has three: as [Md. Afaz Uddin of Jahangirnagar University sets out in the International Journal of English Linguistics](https://www.ccsenet.org/journal/index.php/ijel/article/view/0/41718) (online 30 December 2019), আপনি, তুমি and তুই express "relative rank and deference between speaker and addressee", which English "you" cannot carry.

So the first decision is not which line. It is which of the three you may use.

## তুই, তুমি or আপনি: pick the pronoun before you pick the line

Each tier takes a different verb ending, so the pronoun rewrites the whole sentence. [Ruoan (Margaret) Wang's SALT 34 handout](https://saltconf.github.io/salt34/presentation-materials/wang_tiered.pdf) (MIT, 28 May 2024) gives the Bangla paradigm: তুই takes -িস, তুমি -ও or -এ, আপনি -এন. Right pronoun with the wrong ending reads as broken.

**আপনি (apni) — the formal tier.** Uddin describes it as the usual form between strangers, colleagues, older people and anyone outside your immediate circle. Among strangers, moving off আপনি is itself "a sign of a closer friendship" — the shift is half the proposal, before any words are spoken.

**তুমি (tumi) — the romantic default.** Uddin places তুমি outside the T/V split that describes European languages: semi-formal and emotionally intimate at once, which is the register a proposal needs.

**তুই (tui) — the most intimate and the most dangerous.** The same study lists its uses: among young friends, older to younger family members, child to child — and "when people are angry or hostile towards the addressee(s)". Used upward, it reads as contempt.

Do not hand this choice to an app. [BanglaSocialBench, presented at the ACL Student Research Workshop in July 2026](https://aclanthology.org/2026.acl-srw.22/), tested twelve large language models on 1,719 Bangla instances verified by native speakers and found they "frequently default to overly formal address forms". Machine-translated Bengali arrives in আপনি, which on a proposal reads cold.

## 14 Propose Day quotes in Bengali, grouped by how you address them

### Four lines that use no second-person pronoun at all

No pronoun and no tier-marked verb, so these are safe on any tier.

1. **ভালোবাসি — এইটুকুই, আর কিছু না।** — *Bhalobashi — eituku-i, ar kichhu na.* — "I love you — that much, and nothing else."
2. **ভালোবাসা বলে ফেলার জন্য আজকের দিনটাই বেছে নিলাম।** — *Bhalobasha bole phelar jonno ajker dintai bechhe nilam.* — "Of all days, I picked today to finally say it out loud."
3. **অনেকদিন ধরে জমিয়ে রাখা একটা কথা আছে।** — *Onekdin dhore jomiye rakha ekta kotha achhe.* — "There is one thing I have been saving up for a long time."
4. **মনের কথাটা আজ আর চেপে রাখলাম না।** — *Moner kothata aj ar chepe rakhlam na.* — "Today I am not holding back what is in my heart."

### Four তুমি lines, for a partner or someone you already know well

The default romantic register, right for almost everyone here. Verbs take -ও or -এ.

5. **তোমাকে ভালোবাসি, আজ বলে ফেললাম।** — *Tomake bhalobashi, aj bole phellam.* — "I love you — there, today I have said it."
6. **তোমার হ্যাঁ-টুকুর জন্য আমি সারাজীবন অপেক্ষা করতে রাজি।** — *Tomar hyan-tukur jonno ami sarajibon opekkha korte raji.* — "For that one yes of yours, I am willing to wait a lifetime."
7. **আমার বাকি জীবনটা তোমার সঙ্গে কাটাতে চাই।** — *Amar baki jibonta tomar shonge katate chai.* — "I want to spend the rest of my life with you."
8. **তুমি রাজি থাকলে আজ থেকেই শুরু করি?** — *Tumi raji thakle aj thekei shuru kori?* — "If you are willing, shall we start from today?"

### Three আপনি lines, for a formal or newly-introduced match

For a colleague, someone older, or an introduction made by families. Verbs take -এন. None says ভালোবাসি, deliberately: declaring love at maximum formal distance is incoherent; ভালো লাগে is the register that fits.

9. **আপনাকে ভালো লাগে — কথাটা জানিয়ে রাখা দরকার মনে হল।** — *Apnake bhalo lage — kothata janiye rakha dorkar mone holo.* — "I like you — it felt right to let you know."
10. **আপনি যদি সময় দেন, আমি অপেক্ষা করতে পারি।** — *Apni jodi shomoy den, ami opekkha korte pari.* — "If you give it time, I can wait."
11. **আপনার সঙ্গে জীবনটা কাটাতে চাই — ভেবে উত্তর দেবেন।** — *Apnar shonge jibonta katate chai — bhebe uttor deben.* — "I want to spend my life with you — take your time before you answer."

### Three তুই lines, only for friends since childhood

Only if the two of you have been on তুই since school. Verbs take -িস. On anyone else it lands as contempt.

12. **তুই তো সবই জানিস, তবু আজ মুখে বলি?** — *Tui to shobi janish, tobu aj mukhe boli?* — "You already know all of it — but shall I say it out loud today anyway?"
13. **এতদিন বন্ধু ছিলি, এবার একটু বেশি কিছু হবি?** — *Etodin bondhu chhili, ebar ektu beshi kichhu hobi?* — "You have been my friend all this time — will you be a bit more than that now?"
14. **তোকে ছাড়া কিছু ভাবতেই পারি না, বুঝলি?** — *Toke chhara kichhu bhabtei pari na, bujhli?* — "I cannot think about anything without you — understand?"

## Where West Bengal and Bangladesh usage splits

All 14 lines are standard spoken Bengali and read correctly on both sides of the border. Three differences still matter.

**Vocabulary.** Everyday words diverge — জল (jol) for water in West Bengal against পানি (pani) in Bangladesh, নিমন্ত্রণ against দাওয়াত for an invitation. No line above splits this way, deliberately.

**How far তুই travels in romance.** In West Bengal, couples who were friends first often stay on তুই, and a তুই proposal reads as warm. In Bangladesh the tier skews more towards siblings and childhood friends, so the line risks landing as teasing.

**What choosing Bengali signals.** In Bangladesh the language is not a neutral default. [A 2025 overview in the Khwaja Yunus Ali University Journal](https://journal.kyau.edu.bd/articlesDetail/158) traces how Bengali nationalism was born out of the movement against Urdu as Pakistan's sole state language. In Dhaka the choice is read against that history; in Kolkata it reads as intimacy.

## Getting the line to them when the page around it is English

Four routes, with SubhSandesh's own figures in the last column.

| Route | Does Bengali script survive? | Time it takes | SubhSandesh data, platform-wide across 16 page types |
|---|---|---|---|
| Said out loud | No script involved | Seconds | Not measured — nothing offline recorded |
| WhatsApp or SMS text | Yes, Unicode Bengali renders | Under a minute | 51,504 recorded views, 11.3 per created page |
| An image quote card | Yes, but not selectable or searchable | 10–20 minutes in an editor | Not measured — no image-only pages stored |
| A personalised shared page | Yes, if you paste Unicode not a screenshot | Median 6.4 hours first save to last edit, sampled on /love-gf (n=1,138) | 39.9% password-protect before sharing (1,822 of 4,567) |

The page is the slowest route and the only one that survives the day. Platform-wide, 92.7% of started pages get published and shared (4,234 of 4,567).

Asking someone to marry you? The [proposal scrapbook page](/proposal) is built for that question — your story in order, ending in a YES button that grows every time they dodge it.

Asking someone to be your girlfriend instead? The ["I love you" page](/love-gf) is the honest alternative: the most-created template at 1,138 pages, 24.9% of everything built, and not shaped around marriage.

Be clear on one thing: both templates' interfaces and built-in copy are English, and you paste your Bengali in. Your line renders correctly; the buttons and labels around it stay English. If the person does not read English comfortably, the frame feels foreign even though your words do not — a real limit, not a small one.

## When a Bengali quote is the wrong thing to send

**If you have never used Bengali with them.** A couple who has spoken English or Hinglish since day one will hear a sudden Bengali proposal as a performance, with no established tier to fall back on.

**If your Bengali is shaky and you are copying blind.** Uddin notes that তুই "may confuse a non-native speaker as it has multiple layer of meaning". Read the line aloud to a Bengali-speaking friend first; if it sounds off, use a pronoun-free line.

**If they are in the same room.** 48.9% of SubhSandesh views happen on a phone (25,167 of 51,504), platform-wide — that is someone who is not with you. If they are across the table, say the line out loud; a link between two people at one table is worse than silence.

## Sources

- Md. Afaz Uddin, "Second Person Pronouns as Person Deixis in Bengali and English", *Int. Journal of English Linguistics* 10(1), 30 December 2019 — [ccsenet.org](https://www.ccsenet.org/journal/index.php/ijel/article/view/0/41718)

structuralLimitations: No proposal-specific data exists. A read-only probe of the `proposalpages` collection was refused by this machine's production-read policy in wave 1 and again in this batch, so not one figure on this page may be attributed to proposal pages. Every SubhSandesh number in the body is labelled in the prose itself as platform-wide across all 16 page types, or as sampled on /love-gf with n=1,138. Closes only when a proposal-page read is permitted.
The pricing block in content/facts.md is empty, so this post states and implies no price, no free tier and no paid tier. Closes when someone fills in the pricing block by hand.

Every SubhSandesh template's interface and built-in copy are in English; there is no Bengali-language template. The body says so plainly rather than implying a Bengali reader gets a Bengali product. Closes only if a localised template ships.

SERP analysis was run through the DuckDuckGo HTML endpoint because the session's WebSearch budget was exhausted (200/200) and the Firecrawl MCP required re-authentication. Two of the five incumbents were fetched in full; the other three were assessed from title, snippet and year-stamp only.

OpenAlex and Semantic Scholar returned HTTP 429 throughout, so the literature sweep ran on Crossref, DOAJ and DuckDuckGo instead. A promising Bangla standard-vs-dialect paper (10.4236/ojml.2026.164025) sits behind a 403 on scirp.org and was therefore not read and not cited.

A Pohela Falgun / 13 February framing for Bangladeshi readers was drafted and cut: DuckDuckGo rate-limited before the revised Bangla calendar date could be verified, and an unverified calendar claim is the one error a reader catches instantly.

arxiv.org, pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov and frontiersin.org were all at the 3-post batch cap when this post was written, so a directly relevant arXiv paper on Bangla honorific failures (arXiv:2605.22487) was found, read and deliberately dropped rather than pushing a domain over cap.
